topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: I understand that my neighbor is considering installing a fence. It’s a decision that can affect both of our properties, so I think it’s important to approach this thoughtfully. First, I’d like to talk to them to understand their needs and concerns. Perhaps they feel they need more privacy or security. It could be helpful to discuss our property lines and what kind of fence would be suitable for both of us. By listening to each other, we can make a choice that respects both of our needs. Before any work begins, I also suggest checking local regulations to ensure whatever we decide complies with the rules. This way, we can move forward with a plan that’s agreeable and compliant.
